verdict.rationale: Runloop's evidence does not describe a first-class versioned automation or workflow object. The closest analogs are snapshots, which save devbox disk state and allow rolling back to a known good point. Agent deployment can also be driven from GitHub workflows through the deploy-agent Action, which implies git-based versioning and review, and blueprints define reusable environment templates. Missing for 10: explicit versioning of agents/automations, a built-in review or diff workflow, rollback of deployed agent versions (not just disk state), and independent corroboration.
